recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not re-add referencesContained to core; any future changes to this extension should be made and reconciled in the FHIR Extension Pack repository.
issue_request: FHIR-34264 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core request to add the SDC-originated referencesContained extension so hidden references to contained resources in expressions, XHTML, markdown, strings, or similar content can be made visible for dom-3 validation.
initial_application: Commit 071a1735ce1a9432c31fc6718e18a8ffbc1a14d7 applied the issue in core by adding a referencesContained row to the active source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml extension spreadsheet; the Jira comment cites the same lloyd-changes commit.
additional_context: FHIR-34025 is the SDC-origin decision that created the extension and explains the validator use case. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed extension definitions from R5 core source during the Extension Pack split. The Extension Pack introduction states that globally defined extensions moved out of core starting with R5, and current /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions source defines referencesContained. Later Extension Pack issues FHIR-48947 and FHIR-49855 refined the same extension and are reflected in current extension-pack source.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined core branch. The authoritative current definition belongs to the FHIR Extension Pack, where StructureDefinition-referencesContained.xml defines the canonical URL, OID, contexts, description, and Reference value. Core retains only the canonical OID registration in source/oids.ini, so re-adding an active core extension definition would be wrong.
